description: Returns the calling bridge's managed-session provenance without accepting a caller identity, session key, or provenance blob. Use it when a platform application adapter must attest a downstream action to the current server-derived caller and must refuse rather than guess when the caller cannot be linked to a managed session.
embedding_description: Resolve verified caller provenance for a platform adapter before a downstream write. Returns managed-session and stable agent-session identities plus a grammar-safe directing principal, and fails closed when the caller has no server-derived managed-session link.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Managed-session provenance derived exclusively from server-built action state.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Report only that caller provenance resolved or refused; do not expose an unredacted authenticated principal.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Use the returned opaque identifiers only as adapter provenance fields, never as authority to act for another session.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Resolving a caller-managed-session link for a downstream platform adapter.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: caller_provenance_unavailable means the caller had no server-derived registered or attributed managed-session identity; no partial provenance was returned.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Invoke from a registered bridge or a correctly attributed one-shot route, then retry. Do not supply a session id or substitute operator provenance.
